mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5%, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 months, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals a strong supply-side response, which leads to increased economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 2%, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, which leads to reduced inflation expectations and increased real returns on equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines for 3 months, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate revenues, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 300,000, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to increased economic activity and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals strong economic activity, leading to increased corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
